leads.name: Witominskie Slonca (The Witomino Suns)
leads.why: A group of four Swedish whitebeams beside ul. Sloneczna in Witomino, officially designated as one nature-monument entry by Gdynia city council (Uchwala nr LIV/1660/23, 28 czerwca 2023). Two independent sources corroborate: the city government's own news article (gdynia.pl) and sozosfera.pl, an independent environmental-news site, matching species, street, names and grouping. A genuinely wild, strictly-protected species along this stretch of Baltic coast per the city's own text, not an ornamental planting; two of the four carry the protected lichen Evernia prunastri. Girth is a documented floor only (the city states each measures 'over 200cm', the legal minimum for the species to qualify), not a precise figure. No age given anywhere. Passes the ensemble test on the same grounds as Torun's Trzy Zorze: one register entry, one shared name, one address, one coordinate (confirmed by reverse-geocoding the Commons photo's embedded GPS). Full verified record in data/research/famouspoland-refill-verified.json.
